helptext.en:
Use the Dimension Note field to provide additional context, if needed. For example:

  • ﻿﻿Includes container
  • ﻿﻿Small block
  • ﻿﻿Kit contains parts A and part B

 

For irregular data use the Dimension Note field only:

  • Numeric approximations:
    • appx. 10 g
    • appx. 35 mL
  • ﻿﻿Non-numeric approximations:
    • ﻿﻿very little sample left
    • ﻿﻿a few micrograms
  • ﻿﻿Count of objects:
    • ﻿﻿2 envelopes
    • ﻿﻿4 bottles
    • ﻿﻿2 archive vials (1 taken after sample was cleaned)
  • ﻿﻿Multiple dimensions:
    • ﻿﻿25g x 2
    • ﻿﻿5lbs x 2
    • ﻿﻿8 oz + 1 oz

# General:
This branch allows the classifications themselves to be classified in order to know what sort of type it is, without recognizing all of them individually. This is important when the set of first degree types is not easily enumerable, such as classifications for the type of object or work.  See: https://linked.art/model/base/#types-of-types
